title: OmniBachi Runtime Binding Schema V0
description: JSON Schema for materialized runtime binding artifacts. Structural validation only — semantic binding correctness governed by ASSERT_RB_* handlers.

storage_structure.description: FQDN of the storage structure artifact governing this binding's storage layout

bindings.description: Map of CS FQDN to runtime configuration

fqdn.description: Authoritative declared identity (namespace::code). Folder location has no authority over identity.

supersedes.description: FQDN of the artifact this one stands in place of. A declared relation between two exact identities, not a resolution rule: references stay exact, and a superseded artifact is unreachable rather than absent.

superseded_by.description: FQDNs of the artifacts that stand in this one's place. Several is the ordinary case — one act split in two retires one artifact and authors two. Its presence means the artifact is superseded: unreachable from the executable projections, retained in the canonical set as history.

authority.description: The authority from which this artifact's jurisdiction derives (CA-1, CA-2). Declared, never inferred from namespace, path or kind.

concern.description: The semantic subject this artifact is about (GO-11, ID-12). A concern classification confers no authority and constitutes no boundary.

host.description: Host identifier for the bound side effect

policy.description: Policy configuration (storage path, strict mode, etc.)

config.description: Configuration object (alternative to policy in some binding styles)
